comments: Recording is an hour long ‘best of’ the whole show.
The show is back in it’s traditional 10 till midnight slot, after some months starting at 9pm.
Some of Tommy’s links are cut off, but the beginning and some of the sign-off are both on the recording. The Friday Night Connection is not recorded.
Tommy states that Paul Di’Anno is from East Ham and is a ‘massive football freak’, supporting “either East Ham or West Ham”!!
UPDATE - I have included the full track-listing for this show from notes made at the time by Andy MacGregor. Although they are not on the recording they are listed in italics.

sessions.artist: Dianno: Recorded 21/09/1984 (no commercial release); Paul Di’Anno (vocals)
sessions.details: Paul J Ward (guitar), Lee Slater (guitar), Kevin Browne (bass), Frank Noone (drums), Mark Venables (keyboards)
